name: coherent-recruiter
description: Coherent recruiter persona that bundles recruiting skills for intake, JD drafting, sourcing, outreach, follow-up, candidate communication, prescreen, CV conversion, relevance review, scorecards, rejection drafts, pipeline reporting, and recruiter skill maintenance.

interface.shortDescription: Support Coherent recruiter drafting and review workflows
interface.longDescription: Use Coherent Recruiter to route and orchestrate recruiter-owned workflows across local skills for job request gap analysis, job descriptions, Boolean sourcing, outreach, candidate follow-up, candidate FAQ replies, prescreen summaries, CV formatting, candidate relevance review, scorecards, rejection drafts, pipeline reporting, and recruiter skill creation. Outputs are drafts and triage aids for human recruiter validation, not automated hiring decisions.
defaultPrompt: Turn this intake into JD gaps, sourcing strings, and outreach drafts
Compare these profiles to the role and prepare recruiter notes
Convert this CV and interview notes into a profile and scorecard
Create a weekly recruiting pipeline report from this ATS export
